answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 1468 Country: India Title: Nikah with aunti (chachi) is permissible? Question: Nikah with aunti (chachi) is permissible? Answer ID: 1468 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 848/848=J) Yes, you can marry your aunt after the death of uncle or after divorce provided she passes Iddah (prescribed period), as the Quran says: وأحل لکم ما وراء ذلکم (سورۃ النساء: 24) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
